subject: Security discovery and retention — Fincrest recap & next steps
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.ch@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Liao <tom.liao@fincrest.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.b@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security discovery and retention — recap & next steps

Tom — thanks for the 40-minute discussion earlier. Quick recap of pain, goals, and agreed next steps so we have a single source of truth. Please flag anything I missed or got wrong.

What we heard (pain points)
- You need immutable audit logs and per-request traceability for regulatory review (payments/regulatory audit).
- Current vendor lock-in and unpredictable retention costs are a blocker for procurement.
- Expectations that any third-party must provide SOC 2 Type II artifacts, pen test evidence, and clear data deletion/retention guarantees in the DPA.

Goals we aligned on
1) Confirm Redwood can meet 12–18 month retention for audit logs, exportable in CSV/JSON with request IDs.
2) Validate SOC 2 coverage and provide a scoped artifact bundle for procurement.
3) Agree a timeline for pen test evidence or an acceptable attestation and method for secure transfer of artifacts.
4) Clarify DPA redline path and who on Fincrest legal should own the thread.

Deliverables Redwood will provide
- SOC 2 summary (control mapping + TOC) and a redacted Type II report if available — deliver by Tue 19 May EOD (SOC2-summary-TOC.pdf attached).
- Audit-log schema and example export (CSV + JSON) — ETA Tue 19 May.
- Proposed retention options and pricing levers (batching, kv-cache TTL, and archival policy).
- Pen-test window / evidence options: share scope and a recent attestation; if not possible, propose a pen-test schedule and mitigation plan.

Action owners & cadence
- Irene (me): consolidate evidence and send SOC2-summary + log schema by Tue 19 EOD.
- Marissa: coordinate the secure artifact transfer and procurement fidelity questions (SLA/retention pricing).
- Jordan: join the follow-up technical call to run through log format and private deployment options (dedicated VPC).
- Tom / Fincrest: confirm final POC security contact and whether DPA redline goes to legal@fincrest.com or to security@fincrest.com (please confirm).

Proposed next touchpoints
- Technical deep-dive (Jordan + Infra) — Thu 20 May, 11:00–11:45 PT.
- Procurement/Legal touchpoint (if needed) — week of May 24.

Attachments referenced
- redwood-security-overview.pdf (brief overview of controls, encryption, and deployment modes)

If the above looks good I will send the SOC2-summary + log-schema tomorrow and lock the Thu 20 slot if that works for your engineering/security team.

Thanks again — appreciate the candid requirements.

—
Irene Choi
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene.ch@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0113

Attachment: redwood-security-overview.pdf (application/pdf, 145 KB)

From: Tom Liao <tom.liao@fincrest.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.ch@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.b@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.ai>, Maya Iyer <maya.iyer@fincrest.com>, security@fincrest.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security discovery and retention — recap & next steps

Irene — thanks for the clear summary. Confirming a few items from our side and answering your asks inline.

- Fincrest POC security: Maya Iyer (maya.iyer@fincrest.com) will own technical validation; legal redlines should go to legal@fincrest.com.
- Retention: minimum 12 months of immutable audit logs; preferred 24 months if cost-effective. Logs must include request_id, user_id (hashed), timestamp, action, and full payload hash. Exports in JSON with an index-friendly schema are fine.
- SOC 2: we need the TOC and a redacted Type II report (any interim attestation is helpful).
- Pen test: evidence within last 12 months preferred; if you have only a 13–18 month report we can accept that with a remediation plan and scheduled testing window.
- Encryption: at-rest AES-256 and customer-managed KMS are required for production PII.

I'll attach our internal checklist — that should clarify procurement questions (see attachment). We can take Thu 20 May 11:00 PT for the tech deep-dive; Maya will join as well.

Thanks,
Tom
Director of Risk & Compliance
Fincrest Bank

Attachment: Fincrest-infosec-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 62 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Liao <tom.liao@fincrest.com>, Maya Iyer <maya.iyer@fincrest.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.ch@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.b@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security discovery and retention — recap & next steps

Tom / Maya — looping in procurement/ops next steps. Quick operational commitments from Redwood: 

1) SOC 2 package: attaching a high-level TOC this morning (SOC2-summary-TOC.pdf). We will share a redacted Type II within 24 hours of the call if available; otherwise, we will provide a control mapping and auditor contact for direct verification.
2) Audit logs: Jordan will circulate a sample JSON export and schema before Thu's call. The export will include request_id, hashed user_id, timestamp, action, and a content-hash field — and we can produce either CSV or newline-delimited JSON.
3) Retention / DPA: we support customer-managed retention via our Private/Dedicated options. For hosted deployments, we provide configurable retention buckets (30/90/365/730 days) plus archival export. Pricing for 24-month retention vs 12-month will be included in the proposal.
4) Pen test: if we cannot share a 12-month pen-test report, we will propose a test window within 30–60 days and an interim attestation. We can also provide a remediation backlog and SLAs for critical issues.

Next steps (action items)
- Jordan: sample log schema + secure transfer method (SharePoint link) — by Tue 19 10:00 PT.
- Irene: send SOC2-summary and DPA starter language by EOD Tue 19.
- Marissa: prepare pricing delta for 12 vs 24 month retention and attach to proposal.

We'll confirm Thu 20 11:00 PT in a separate calendar invite (invitation to follow).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.c@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0127
